continuity_scope: VIZ Media English Bleach, Vol. 1 paperback/digital edition, ISBN 9781591164418 (publisher product page lists eISBN-13 9781421543642), credited to Tite Kubo and released by VIZ on 17 June 2011. The selected witness is the exact official VIZ Volume 1 page and its 59-page free preview reader. VIZ exposes no individual chapter locator for that preview, so the primary locator is recorded as Volume 1 preview pages 1–59 and claims are further limited to the publisher's Volume 1 synopsis. The Japanese Shueisha serialization/volumes, later English volumes and omnibus editions, anime, films, games, novels, guidebooks, sequel/spinoff works, and every other adaptation are separate witnesses or continuities.

coverage_rule: All named individual dramatic figures named in the selected VIZ Volume 1 synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki. This is a narrow official-metadata pass rather than a complete extraction of the 59-page preview or full volume. Soul Reapers and Hollows as categories, Soul Society, spiritual powers/energy, ghosts and other spirits, family, places, factions, weapons, and themes are dimensions or terms rather than character nodes.
omissions: Every named or unnamed person, Soul Reaper, Hollow, spirit, ghost, faction, weapon/entity, and later-introduced figure not named in the selected VIZ Volume 1 synopsis, including figures visually present but not textually identified under this metadata rule.

All detailed preview or volume events, later identities, powers, training, weapons, faction structures, deaths, transformations, battles, outcomes, and later arc material; the original Japanese text except as a separate bibliographic witness; and later volumes/omnibus editions, anime, films, games, novels, guidebooks, sequel/spinoff works, and other adaptations.

uncertainties: The consulted VIZ product page credits story and art but does not name a translator. Its metadata labels the book as 192 pages while the free-preview reader exposes 59 preview pages; this pass does not infer a chapter breakdown from either display.

Soul Reaper, Soul Society, Hollow, ghost, spirit, and afterlife language are source-specific manga fiction in this record. They are not descriptions of real religion, death, spiritual practice, or a claim that any tradition uses these terms in the same way.

The premise includes attacks, predatory spirits, threatened family members, power loss/transfer, death and afterlife imagery, and paranormal violence. These are fictional content cautions, not real-world medical, safety, or religious guidance.
evidence_basis: Official VIZ Volume 1 product metadata/synopsis plus its official 59-page free-preview reader location. The reader provides the primary-volume locator but not separately exposed chapter identifiers; detailed claims remain constrained to the publisher synopsis. No fan or secondary source is used as canonical evidence.
